name: Google Gemini & DeepMind
description: Gemini models and app, the Gemini API and AI Studio, Gemini in Workspace and Android, and DeepMind research.

items.title: Google DeepMind and Springer Nature partner to develop an AI peer-review assistant
items.summary: Google DeepMind and Springer Nature announced a research partnership to co-design an AI assistant for peer reviewers. The prototype is intended to help researchers navigate manuscripts and analyze text, charts, and figures while keeping expert human judgment central.

items.title: Gemini API enables request storage by default for new paid-tier projects
items.summary: Starting October 26, new paid-tier projects using the Gemini Generate Content API store requests by default (`store=true`); existing projects retain their current setting. Developers can opt out by setting `store=false` per request or turning off API logging in AI Studio.

items.title: Google DeepMind releases a global map of forest types
items.summary: Google DeepMind and Google Research, working with the World Resources Institute and IIASA, released Forest Typology 2020, a global 10-meter-resolution map distinguishing six forest and land-use types. They also shared an early time series tracking changes from 2017 to 2025, including natural forests converted to plantations or farms.
